opening.argument: The video presents ordinary Uber promotions through visible in-app offers, referral credits, and a demonstrated discount rather than a deceptive demand. The Promotions screen lists multiple ride discounts, including $50 OFF offers for three rides, while the Free Rides screen explains that referring a friend can provide a ride worth up to ₹25 and displays an invite code with WhatsApp sharing. A separate share screen shows routine destinations including Email, Gmail, Hangouts, WhatsApp, Messaging, Bluetooth, and Drive. The ride-request screen then shows “Promo Applied” with a displayed fare of “₹0.00,” consistent with a promotion being demonstrated. The title identifies the subject as Uber free-ride and promo-code content, and the requests to subscribe, like, and share are ordinary audience-engagement prompts rather than conditions for receiving the offer.
